reasons: Datadog system.load.15 is the 15-minute load average, but the candidate selects system.cpu.load_average.1m, the 1-minute average. That is a different quantity.

The correct metric is the 15-minute counterpart, system.cpu.load_average.15m, with the same gauge selector and avg aggregation. The candidate's definition for that metric was not supplied, so its existence and dataset presence could not be verified here.
The template variable $scope has no prefix and default '*', so dropping it is correct and no matcher is needed.
Load average is a gauge, so no rate() is involved and none is wanted. Unit is unitless on both sides ({thread} in OTel, unitless in Datadog), so no scale applies.
